sections.title: Master Sanitation Schedule (reference)
sections.description: Defines the scheduled cleaning of the facility, equipment, and storage areas — what is cleaned, how, when, and who is responsible (SQF 11.2.5.1). Daily production-day cleaning is recorded on the Daily Sanitation & Pre-Operation Record (FRM-903) and each machine's SSOP log; periodic cleaning is recorded below as it is completed (SQF 11.2.5.8, 11.2.5.9).

fields.label: Cleaning schedule
rows: Cleaned & sanitized per each machine's SOP/SSOP; recorded on its own log
Under pallets / bottom rack spaces in storage

sections.title: Periodic Cleaning — Completion Record
sections.description: Record each scheduled periodic (monthly / 6-month) cleaning as it is completed, and have it verified. This forms part of the cleaning records required by SQF 11.2.5.9. One record per completed task; the Records report shows completions over time.
